title: Send button not pressable by accessibility services (voice keyboard can't hit Send)
description:
The chat composer's send/stop button renders fine but is not clickable to Android accessibility services. Root cause: Semantics(excludeSemantics: true) in ChatComposer._buildSendButton drops the inner IconButton's tap action, so the merged node is a non-clickable button (label='Send message', isButton, isEnabled, no tap action). BubbleKeyboard's send finder requires clickable within 4 ancestors, so the swipe-to-send gesture can never find it.

Fix: re-declare onTap (streaming ? onStop : onSend) on the Semantics wrapper.

Discovered while wiring BubbleKeyboard's swipe-to-finish-recording-and-send flow against Hermes.
close_reason: Fixed in 3678eb6 on fix/send-button-accessibility; test-verified. On-device check with BubbleKeyboard pending.

comments.author: Ryder Cobean
comments.text:
Fixed on branch fix/send-button-accessibility, commit 3678eb6: onTap re-declared on the Semantics wrapper in lib/core/widgets/chat_composer.dart.

Verification: probe widget test confirmed the merged node had no tap action before the fix and does after (hasTap=false → true). Two regression tests in test/chat_composer_test.dart perform the semantics tap action (what a voice keyboard's ACTION_CLICK dispatches) and assert onSend/onStop fire. Full composer + accessibility suites pass (60 tests), analyzer clean on touched files.

Remaining: on-device verification with BubbleKeyboard swipe gesture after installing a build with this fix.
